§v0.9.5

October 06, 2026
  • feat: working Kbd shortcuts, a two-way questionnaire flow diagram, parallax in the website templates, diagrams that fit their column, incremental e2e
  • kbd: every shortcut the docs show really runs - through df$.shadcn.shared.bindGlobalKeys - and the key goes down while it runs (data-pressed); the command palette's ⌘K now uses the shared listener too
  • questionnaire: toDiagram() and linkDiagram() - the flow as an Illustrative Diagram that follows the form and drives it: back to any step taken, forward only to the next reachable step, further on refused (questionnaire-jump-refused); the Mermaid flow example moves to the Mermaid page
  • diagram: a narrow figure first gives its column gaps and minimums, then scales the canvas to fit (data-fit="none" opts out), with 2rem canvas padding; ```diagram fences in docs pages - the Component Skills page diagram is animated and interactive
  • website templates: the Seven planes parallax as the Events "Summit Night" hero, the sticky fly-through on the Landing page; decorative separators in the Modern Paper
  • separator: a real decorative example - ornamental section breaks and an accent rule; shapes: filled stacks fade sheet by sheet toward the background, centered pattern labels
  • table: plain links in cells take the text colour with a soft underline; statistic: a compact card in "In Cards"; charts: the claims-sequence contract as prose; accessibility: a live example and the Code Mockup window instead of the old demo block
  • numbers and dates follow the language of the text (textLocale: the nearest [lang], else en), never the browser - English formatting everywhere; counters start at 0 or the next power of ten and never leave that range
  • verify: a "pinned versions" gate - every defuss-shadcn@vX.Y.Z pin in the docs names the current release, and bump-version moves them
  • e2e: bun run e2e runs only the files whose inputs changed since they last passed (scripts/lib/e2e-select.ts); --all / E2E_ALL=1 for releases, --list to preview
  • feat: HTML Preview Editor (code-example) in the wysiwyg extra bundle; Papers (Modern Paper, BibTeX); big-data, diagram, questionnaire and property-grid components
  • code-example: the docs CodeExample card as a shipped component - editable source over a Shiki paint layer, sandboxed srcdoc preview, device toolbar with resize handles, zoom, fullscreen, schema-generated State tab; states default / code / state / fullscreen, el.preview drives the previewed component, df$.shadcn.codeExample.configure()
  • wysiwyg.css / wysiwyg.js: extra bundle (scripts/lib/bundles.ts) kept out of all.*, built from the bound dist files; every doc page loads it after all.*; verify, minify and stats know it
  • removed the tokenizer-based code-editor component and the docs sandbox templates
  • Papers: Modern Paper technical report (growth per week, LOC, review load, VAE dialect) and the BibTeX component
  • per-app bundles, flagship deck figures, make bench (verify timing: 242 e2e files, 78 gates), build-docs memory fix
  • fix(scaffolds): Aron Homberg with his GitHub avatar is the signed-in user in every scaffold - Admin Dashboard, Messenger, Issue Tracker, Notes & Docs, Desktop
  • fix(scaffolds): the owner's avatar in the Desktop (Settings, Start menu) and Messenger (Settings) profiles

§v0.9.4

October 02, 2026 d6ff358a
  • feat(scaffolds): new Application Scaffolds - whole clickable applications built only from the shipped components; each gets a full-screen page (app-*.html) generated from its docs example, and an e2e test that drives it
  • feat(scaffolds): Admin Dashboard - sidebar and ⌘K palette, KPIs with live charts, orders with tabs and bulk actions, customers, settings with a guarded danger zone
  • feat(scaffolds): Messenger - a WhatsApp-style chat: filters, voice notes, photos, replies and reactions, live sending with read receipts and typing replies, calls, contact info and a resizable chat list
  • feat(scaffolds): Issue Tracker - a Linear-style tracker: issues as a list or a drag-and-drop board, issue pages with editable properties and comments, right-click actions, C / J / K shortcuts, inbox, cycles with a burn-up chart, projects
  • feat(scaffolds): Notes & Docs - a Notion-style workspace: page tree, block editor with a slash menu, markdown shortcuts, a format bar and drag to move, sharing, favorites, trash, and a database with table / board / gallery views
  • feat(scaffolds): Status Page - a Statuspage-style page: overall status, incident timelines, a maintenance countdown, 90-day uptime bars and metrics - plus the console that creates, updates and resolves incidents live
  • feat(scaffolds): Desktop - a Windows-style desktop: movable windows, taskbar, start menu with search, quick settings, a calendar clock, context menus for layout and theme, an editor, a calculator, a real iframe browser, settings, a recycle bin and a lock screen
  • feat(website): seven new Website sections - Company, Events & Promotions, Media, Shop, Account & States (with a 404 page), Docs & Help, Search & Navigation - 98 new CSS-only blocks, each section with a live template page
  • feat(website): more variants for Site Header, Hero, Product Showcase, Testimonials, Feature Details, Pricing, Stats, Newsletter, Get In Touch, Blog, FAQ and Site Footer
  • feat(resizer): data-variant="divider" - a split pane's edge: a full-length strip that shows a line on hover, focus and drag, and resets on double-click
  • fix(context-menu): near the viewport edge the menu opens toward the other side of the pointer, like a native menu, instead of running off screen
  • fix(chart, sidebar, table): resize work runs on the next frame - no more "ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications"
  • fix(session): bubble tails, reactions and focus rings are no longer clipped by the rows' paint containment
  • fix(badge): a badge never wraps its label or shrinks in a flex row (as in shadcn/ui)
  • fix(table): row headers (th.table-cell scope="row") align to the start like a cell
  • fix(docs): code blocks inside Website blocks keep their own styling; the Form page's switch rows get their gap
